premises: A three-dimensional twin network forms within individual grains in CrCoNi MEA during deformation.
This twin network provides substantial barriers for dislocation motion, contributing to high strength and strain hardening.
The twin network simultaneously permits significant plastic deformation by providing pathways for dislocation motion.
The high propensity for twinning in fcc CrCoNi is a factor in its excellent strength, ductility, and toughness.
The formation of the 3D twin network is stable against de-twinning and occurs in relatively large grains.
